description: HoogspanningsNet maintains a public database-backed map of large electricity networks in the Netherlands, Belgium and selected interconnected European countries. The map distinguishes overhead lines, underground cables, substations and large producers or consumers, with information attached to individual objects. The inspected viewer identifies version 6.5, released in February 2025; individual feature survey dates and update intervals are not stated. Viewing is free, and the data carry CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 conditions. The separate user agreement prohibits automated database queries, copying through scripts and commercial applications without permission. No bulk export was verified. A limitation is that volunteers do not guarantee completeness or positional correctness, and the provider explicitly excludes use for excavation or other critical operational decisions. Simulation uses are therefore bounded to educational network interpretation and checking the plausibility of study areas within the permitted terms. No matching catalogue or first-review draft was identified. This record is an information source, not a claim that an unrestricted machine-readable grid model is available. Only public map documentation and the user agreement were inspected. It complements data-entsoe-transmission-system-grid-map as a more local grid information source, subject to its stricter reuse conditions.
